description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of data points across six categories, labeled 0 through 5. The chart contains six slices, each representing a different category. Following this is slice ‘3’, light orange, at approximately 6.8% (2002 data points), slice ‘4’, light green, at approximately 6.2% (1810 data points), and finally slice ‘5’, light blue, representing approximately 10.4% (3043 data points). The largest slice, ‘0’, is slightly offset from the center. Each slice includes a percentage label and the corresponding data point count. A legend is not present, but each slice is directly labeled with its category number. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, generally from larger to smaller proportions.
